description: Run recipes on the batch control system: weigh and dose raw materials (including 35% hydrogen peroxide and 50% sodium hydroxide from connected totes), heat T-1, mix, and record the batch
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 85% of volume runs through T-1 and T-2 (about $3,700 of shipments a day); finished-goods stock covers the top 40 SKUs for about 3 working days; a wrong dose or temperature can cause an exothermic reaction or an off-spec product. RPO 24 h is the target for recipes and HMI configuration; today the newest recipe copy can be a month old (monthly USB export)
manual_workaround: Stop automatic dosing. Make simple non-peroxide products (about 40% of volume) with the portable mixer, floor-scale weighing, and paper batch tickets checked by a second person; peroxide products wait for a trusted HMI
dependent_third_parties: Control system integrator; raw material suppliers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Blend Operators; Operations Manager; blend room

description: Fill pails, jugs, drums, and totes; apply GHS labels and DOT markings printed from the SDS and label service
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Product can wait in mix tanks or totes for a few days; labels must match the current SDS (hazard communication) and DOT markings
manual_workaround: Pre-printed label stock for the top 30 SKUs; hand-applied DOT labels from the shipping binder
dependent_people_or_facilities: Warehouse and Shipping Lead; Blend Operators

description: Take orders, allocate lots, invoice, and record receipts in the accounting and inventory service
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $22,000 invoiced per week; the service also produces the bills of lading for BP-04. RPO 1 h comes from the vendor's replication stated in its SOC 2 report (P09)
manual_workaround: Paper order log and invoices queued for entry; customer pickups recorded on paper
dependent_third_parties: Accounting and inventory service vendor; MSP; internet provider

description: Prepare shipping papers with hazmat descriptions and the ERI emergency number, apply placards, and hand shipments to LTL carriers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Shipping is the only source of revenue (about $4,400 a day); offering hazmat without correct shipping papers or a working emergency response number is a DOT violation (49 CFR 172.201; 172.604)
manual_workaround: Handwritten bills of lading from the printed hazmat description sheet for each SKU in the shipping binder; ERI contract number on the binder cover
dependent_third_parties: LTL carriers; 24-hour ERI provider; accounting and inventory service vendor
dependent_people_or_facilities: Warehouse and Shipping Lead; loading dock

business_process: Quality control and certificates of analysis
description: Test each batch (pH, specific gravity, active content), release it, and issue certificates of analysis
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Private-label and food-plant customers will not accept product without a certificate; QC catches a wrong dose before shipping
manual_workaround: Paper QC worksheets; certificates typed from a template on any clean laptop

description: Keep master formulations, HMI recipes, and SDSs current and consistent
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Formulations are the company's main asset (trade secrets); an altered recipe or SDS could harm a customer; the ERI provider must hold current SDS information before product is offered (172.604(b)(2))
manual_workaround: Owner's paper formulation binder (updated quarterly); SDS PDFs held by the ERI provider
dependent_third_parties: SDS and label service vendor; 24-hour ERI provider; MSP

description: Call 911 for any fire or release, then the National Response Center, the LEPC, and the SERC when a release reaches a reportable quantity; notify the ERI provider and carriers of transport incidents
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Release notices are due immediately (40 CFR 302.6; 355.43). Today the call list exists only in the office phone system, which runs over the office network
manual_workaround: Printed call list at the blend room exit, the loading dock, and in the Operations Manager's truck; staff cell phones

description: Order raw materials within the inventory limits, check deliveries (including hydrogen peroxide totes) against orders, and store them in the locked room
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Two weeks of raw material on hand for most items; the inventory limits (no hydrogen peroxide at 52% or higher; 2 totes at most) are checked at each order
manual_workaround: Phone and email orders to suppliers; paper receiving log
dependent_people_or_facilities: Operations Manager; Warehouse and Shipping Lead

description: Biweekly payroll through the payroll service; HR files; payables
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly; the company holds a cash reserve of about 30 days of expenses
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll through the payroll service's web portal from any clean device
